financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM sales of 2,173,913 shares between April 1, 2023 and filing date
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: From April 1, 2023 to the date of this filing, we issued and sold an aggregate of 2,173,913 shares of common stock pursuant to the Sales Agreement for aggregate net proceeds of $24.2 million, after deducing fees.
